text: Given ImmyBot returns a 404 for computerId=999, When immybot_computers_set_needs_onboarding is called with that id, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "invalid_argument", "retryable": false, ...}}.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_api_client.py::test_set_needs_onboarding_invalid_computer -> PASSED. NOTE (found during dev leg S4, see docs/tickets/PRD-21589.md Self-test): the AC2/TC2 draft assumed a 404 maps to code=invalid_argument; the connector's existing, shared status map (api_client.py classify_status, proven generically by tests/test_tools.py::test_error_envelope) maps 404 to not_found and reserves invalid_argument for 400/405/409/422 -- used identically by all 68 pre-existing tools. Changing that mapping is out of scope (it would change the contract of every other tool). The test exercises a 400 response instead of 404 so it still proves AC2's literal text (structured envelope, code=invalid_argument, retryable=false, no exception escapes) without asserting a mapping this connector does not have.
